text:
olga: working on a "chain bill" card for the console. want to show per-hop token counts, cache delta, and an estimated $ cost per invocation. thoughts on sampling and attribution? :money_with_wings:
trevor: define sampling tiers: tiny (0.1%) for full payloads, small (1%) for hop lists, and large (100%) for light summaries (counts only). that keeps ingest sane.
mina: agree. add fields: chain_id, hop_index, sku, in_tokens, out_tokens, cache_hit, precision, fallback. include an anonymized salted hash for cache_key. no raw prompt text.
olga: attribution question: if hop B benefits from a cache write by hop A on prior invocation, who gets the credit? i want transparent view for chargebacks.
trevor: emit separate cache_events (write/hit) with origin_chain_id and beneficiary_chain_id (if available). analytics joins by cache_key_hash over a TTL window. keep routing logic simple.
telemetry-bot: estimate +8% ingest at 1% sampling; +0.3% storage monthly if samples TTL=21d.
storage-bot: recommend partition by date/tenant/route; gzip ndjson. keep raw sample TTL=21d, rollups preserved.
mina: UX: card default shows daily avg cost and a "simulate" control to swap in a different sku for a hop and preview delta (p50/p90 + CI). show sample count and reliability badges.
olga: next: trevor PR schema + example payloads, mina to mock card, i'll write product brief and include privacy redaction rules. sync tomorrow 11am.
